live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#711). Five arms at track-p 769f3fbd (all three settings ship 0): ctl; bundle
(fast_fragile_escape_quantile 75, fast_fragile_heal_floor 50, fast_fragile_count_dot 1); q75; floor50; dot (each part alone). Supersedes #672's pin.
Pilot as a gate, then the full tier (classes-1800 starts 901-1800, 900 per arm), matching #695 and #702; if capacity is short, ctl and bundle in full
first and the single-setting arms at big. Tier full: classes-1800 starts 901-1800 (900 per arm), 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core. Gate: no config_error; one
binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm.
Report per arm and class against ctl: deaths and causes, rescued and newly killed (exact McNemar), CL and depth, alive at the cap having reached DL5,
identical plays; deaths to fast-fragile monsters (crow, wild cat, cave spider ...); games that die with a healing potion in the pack; Phase Door scrolls
used per game. Fast-fragile decisions are rare (about 1 game in 60, #660, #596). Tiers of one study pooled (RULES 14). Descriptive. Whether the bundle
stays on in harness/borg.txt is a borg-reborn-rs decision on this run.
